runners.name: The Mean Fiddler
runners.spotlight: By No Nay Never; has finished a clear second in a Pontefract maiden (5f, good to firm) and a 6f Ripon novice (good); wore a tongue-tie on both occasions but that is now discarded; an obvious candidate but he drops to a sharp 5f from 6f.
runners.comment: Promise over 5f and 6f, at Pontefract and Ripon; tongue-tie discarded; chance

runners.name: Calef
runners.spotlight: Fairly exposed now and was behind The Mean Fiddler at Pontefract (5f, good) two runs ago; has a bit to find with an official mark of 67.
runners.comment: Fairly exposed and has a bit to find with The Mean Fiddler on their form at Pontefract

runners.name: By Jove Grace
runners.spotlight: Fair second in four-runner maiden on Carlisle debut (5f, good) but beaten over 6l when last of five at Ripon (5f, good) since; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Fair debut run at Carlisle but needs to bounce back from lesser run at Ripon last time
runners.owner: Mpr, A & Glo Outlaw & K Quinn

runners.name: Sable Noir
runners.spotlight: Didn't look straightforward when tailed off last of eight on her 5f debut at Catterick (33-1) in June; hood now tried; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Didn't look straightforward when last of 8 on her debut; hood now tried; best watched

runners.name: Paphos
runners.spotlight: 14,000euros yearling; 60,000euros breeze-up buy in May; second foal; Kodi Bear half-brother to Italian 7f 2yo winner; dam useful 6f winner; could go well on debut.
runners.comment: 60,000euros breeze-up buy; dam useful 6f winner; interesting newcomer

runners.name: La Flor Granada
runners.spotlight: Weakened to finish nearly 10l last of eight on her debut at Ayr ten days ago (6f, good to soft; 50-1); may do better at 5f but improvement needed.
runners.comment: Last of eight on her Ayr debut and needs to improve for both that run and the drop in trip

runners.name: Classyfied
runners.spotlight: Filly by Advertise; showed a little promise when over 5l fifth of six on her Beverley debut 11 days ago; should improve for that run.
runners.comment: Some promise when over 5l fifth of six on her Beverley debut; should improve on that

runners.name: Pivotal Star
runners.spotlight: By speedy juvenile Ubettabelieveit; dropped away to finish 17l last of 11 on Thirsk debut ten days ago (6f, good; 50-1); major improvement clearly needed.
runners.comment: Finished 17l last of 11 on Thirsk debut ten days ago (6f, good; 50-1)

runners.name: Bluestone Lady
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at this track (7f, good) last month; never recovered from a slow start when fourth of five in a selling nursery back here ((7f, good) 17 days ago; at least she has a win under her belt now up in trip but others may be more progressive.
runners.comment: Won 7f nursery here last month; slowly away since; now up in trip

runners.name: Le Grand Etoile
runners.spotlight: First sign of ability when fifth in a Hamilton maiden (5f, good to soft) in June; gelded subsequently; well held when beaten 16l on nursery debut at Leicester (7f, good to firm) last month but steps up in trip and may be worth another chance.
runners.comment: Well held when beaten 16l on nursery debut at Leicester last month; now up in trip

runners.name: Forest Berry
runners.spotlight: Showed improvement to score at the sixth attempt in a Wolverhampton maiden (7f, AW) last Monday in a first-time hood (retained); steps up to 1m on nursery debut and holds sound claims.
runners.comment: Improved to win a Wolverhampton maiden last Monday; upped to 1m on nursery debut

runners.name: The Resdev Rocket
runners.spotlight: Has shown only modest form in three contests; steps up in trip on nursery debut and market will be best guide.
runners.comment: Has shown only modest form in three contests; steps up in trip on nursery debut.

runners.name: Bonjour Belle
runners.spotlight: Hasn't finished closer to the winner than her debut fifth in a Chester seller (7f, good to soft; beaten about 3l) in June; steps up in trip but hard to fancy in her third nursery.
runners.comment: Well beaten in two nurseries at about 7f; now goes up in trip but hard to fancy

runners.name: Rule Of The Agency
runners.spotlight: Showed ability when 7l third in a York novice (7f, good to firm) on second start but beaten over 18l by the same rival in a similar contest at Ripon (1m, good) nine days ago; dons first-time cheekpieces on nursery debut and may well show more.
runners.comment: Best form when third in York 7f novice on second start; may do better on nursery debut

runners.name: Astral Calling
runners.spotlight: Has shown little in three runs at about 7f but she's well bred and from a leading yard so significant improvement could easily be on the cards now moving into a nursery.
runners.comment: Has shown little in three runs so far but open to improvement now in a nursery

runners.name: Mayor Of Maghera
runners.spotlight: Both wins on this track, the latest over C&D off this mark in first-time cheekpieces in June (good); hasn't done as well since, but an interesting contender on a track where his record is 2131.
runners.comment: Both wins on this track, latest in June; not fared as well since; interesting back here

runners.name: Titainium
runners.spotlight: Three Flat wins, latest off 7lb higher at Wetherby in June 2025 (1m2f, good to firm); well beaten on first two runs (following a break) this term, but shaped better on AW latest (1m3f); still has a bit to prove at present.
runners.comment: Three Flat wins, latest at Wetherby in June 2025; 7lb lower; mainly below par this term

runners.name: Motawaared
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden; beaten less than 2l when fourth at Ayr last time (1m2f, good to soft; second run after wind op); fair run in first-time cheekpieces in June and they are tried for the second time; each-way chance.
runners.comment: 0-13; beaten less than 2l when 4th at Ayr last time; cheekpieces back on; each-way chance

runners.name: Miners Gamble
runners.spotlight: C&D winner off 7lb higher in August 2024; mixed form since but sound run when third over C&D  (good; second run after wind op, first with a tongue-tie) 17 days ago; has a chance on that run.
runners.comment: C&D winner off 7lb higher in 2024; sound run over C&D latest, and chance on that form

runners.name: Falcon Nine
runners.spotlight: Two wins last season, the second over C&D last August off this mark; runner-up on his last three starts, beaten 1.25l by a previous winner over C&D last time; contender.
runners.comment: Two wins last season; has finished 2nd four times this term, including over C&D last time

runners.name: Runninsonofagun
runners.spotlight: Usually a front-runner; doesn't have the best of strike-rates (2-22) but three good runs in blinkers  at Ayr (1m; all on good to firm; has form on good to soft) in June and he stays this trip; a possible.
runners.comment: Only 2-22, but has done well since blinkers went on and should go well from the front

runners.name: Princess Niyla
runners.spotlight: Record of 3-33 on turf; good third at Doncaster in July (1m, good to firm) but well beaten last time (1m2f, good to firm); lacks consistency.
runners.comment: 3-33 on turf; good 3rd at Doncaster two runs back but well beaten last time; inconsistent

runners.name: Yermanthere
runners.spotlight: Comes here in decent form having won at Ripon in June and finished a close second to a stablemate there last month (also 1m2f, good); contender.
runners.comment: In good form having won at Ripon in June and finished 2nd there last month; contender

runners.name: Theme Park
runners.spotlight: Three good runs since the tongue-tie went on, last time finishing third of five at Nottingham (8.5f, good to firm); each-way chance.
runners.comment: Three good runs since tongue tied, including when third last week; each-way chance

runners.name: Langton Wold
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced in recent seasons and hasn't shown his best form since returning from a long break this term; 5lb out of the handicap; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Lightly raced in recent years; below par after long break this term; 5lb out the weights
runners.owner: Brian Ellison Racing Club & M Dale

runners.name: Simple Star
runners.spotlight: Three wins over 1m4f here, the latest off 4lb higher last August (good) when with Dianne Sayer; tailed off over 1m5f here last time (slowly away); takes a significant drop in trip; cheekpieces tried.
runners.comment: Three wins over 1m4f here; tailed off last time; down in trip with cheekpieces now tried

runners.name: Blakefell
runners.spotlight: Won a C&D maiden on reappearance in May (good); two sound runs since, latest a short-head second to a subsequent easy winner in a 7f Kempton handicap; up 3lb; chance.
runners.comment: Won C&D maiden on reappearance; short-head 2nd to subsequent winner on AW latest; chance
runners.owner: Alfa Site Services Ltd & Graeme Curnow

runners.name: The Resdev Scholar
runners.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick on final three starts last term, the first in a 7f seller here (good), the last two in handicaps on heavy ground; mainly in good form this season and could go well on return from a break.
runners.comment: Won last 3 races last term, including over C&D; fair form this term; could go well
runners.owner: N Bradley 29, Resdev & South Bank Racing

runners.name: Carmel Valley
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; sound efforts when placed in two handicaps at Ayr in July (7f/1m, good/good to firm); below par on softer ground last time; could bounce back.
runners.comment: Below best on easy ground last time but has a chance on her two placed runs at Ayr in July

runners.name: Light The Night Up
runners.spotlight: Placed three times, all on the AW, from four starts last season; hasn't progressed this year; well handicapped but others appeal more.
runners.comment: Placed 3 times on AW in 2025; hasn't progressed in h'caps this term but on a good mark now

runners.name: Two Commanders
runners.spotlight: Unexposed; won a 6f Catterick novice in June (good to soft); two fair runs since, including second on handicap debut at Catterick last time (6f, good to firm); should be capable of better but was below par on only previous run at 7f (debut).
runners.comment: Unexposed 6f novice winner; two sound runs since; should go well but 7f a slight worry

runners.name: Yy Spirit
runners.spotlight: Won 6f Newcastle novice for Ed Bethell last December; well beaten all three starts in handicaps for new yard this year, including on first try at 7f last time; on a good mark but a bit to prove.
runners.comment: 6f AW win for Ed Bethell; well beaten in h'caps (over 7f latest); good mark; bit to prove

runners.name: Viper
runners.spotlight: Unexposed; won 7f Newcastle novice in June having previously finished runner-up in a 6f maiden at Pontefract (good to soft); not so good on handicap debut last time (AW) but not out of it.
runners.comment: AW winner in June; fair run on turf previous start; poor run last time (AW); not out of it

runners.name: Siouxpersonic
runners.spotlight: Won a 5f AW maiden for Ed Bethell last September; two fair runs in 6f turf handicaps on first two starts this term (with a hood on second occasion); tried in cheekpieces last time (met trouble); now up in trip with a hood back on.
runners.comment: 5f AW maiden win for Ed Bethell; two fair runs in 6f h'caps this term; chance up in trip

runners.name: Velvet Rhythm
runners.spotlight: Down the field in a 6f Goodwood handicap last time; in good form earlier in the season with two wins in 7f fillies' handicaps at Catterick; a possible.
runners.comment: Well beaten over 6f latest, but two wins in 7f Catterick handicaps before that; a possible
runners.owner: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum

runners.name: Beyond The Bar
runners.spotlight: Won 7f handicap at Catterick off 2lb lower in July (good to firm); bit disappointing last two starts (over 1m/7.5f); may fare better back down in trip.
runners.comment: Won 7f Catterick h'cap in July; below that over 7.5f/1m since; may fare better back at 7f

runners.name: Wee Mary
runners.spotlight: Doesn't win very often but had her day in the sun when making all over C&D in June off 4lb lower; largely consistent since but win record of 1-20 on turf is offputting.
runners.comment: Doesn't win very often but made all over C&D in June off 4lb lower.

runners.name: Sixcor
runners.spotlight: Has been a grand servant to the yard with two of his nine wins coming over C&D; latest success came at Ayr (5f, good to firm) last month and he should not be far away.
runners.comment: Has been a grand servant to the yard with two of his nine wins coming over C&D.

runners.name: Opal Storm
runners.spotlight: Landed her fifth win in a Beverley handicap (5f, good to firm) last month; had excuses subsequently but never showed back there 11 days ago; drops back in class and is on her last winning mark so may well show more.
runners.comment: Landed her fifth win in a Beverley handicap last month.

runners.name: Lady Bouquet
runners.spotlight: Has made the frame in four of her last six starts; just needs to show a little more to get involved.
runners.comment: Has made the frame in four of her last six starts.

runners.name: Gwen Tennyson
runners.spotlight: 0-9 but has shown enough to suggest her turn is not far off; closest when beaten 1l at Catterick (5f, good to firm) this month.
runners.comment: 0-9 but has shown enough to suggest her turn is not far away.

runners.name: Ski Angel
runners.spotlight: Her last three wins have all been over C&D but she hasn't been firing recently; the return to this track for the first time this year needs to have an impact.
runners.comment: Her last three wins have all been over C&D but she hasn't been firing recently.

runners.name: Royal Duke
runners.spotlight: Two of his three wins have been over C&D but losing run is mounting up; first-time tongue-tie could do with having a positive effect.
runners.comment: Two of his three wins have been over C&D but losing run is mounting up.

runners.name: Breeze Star
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who has been well held since his debut fifth at Doncaster last July; makes stable debut but others have stronger claims.
runners.comment: Eight-race maiden who has been well held since his debut fifth at Doncaster last July.

runners.name: Sands Of Seve
runners.spotlight: Has claims on his short-head defeat over C&D (good) in June off this mark but has failed to back up that run twice since; usual headgear left off here.
runners.comment: Has claims on his short-head defeat over C&D in June off this mark.

runners.name: So Grateful
runners.spotlight: He's won six times and has been runner-up in his last three contests, latest when jockey dropped her whip when in front inside the final furlong at Yarmouth (6f, good to firm); he may well gain compensation today.
runners.comment: Has won six times; runner-up in his last three contests and his turn may well be near.

runners.name: Misemerald
runners.spotlight: Winless since 2yo days; competitive at this sort of level all summer but a couple of costly defeats here latterly (7f) and needs to find more.
runners.comment: Competitive at this sort of level all summer but needs to find more back up in trip

runners.name: Hostelry
runners.spotlight: Combination of a first-time visor and drop to 0-50 classified company enough to see her end a losing run a fortnight ago; win last August came off a stone-higher mark and she's shortlisted now back in the groove.
runners.comment: Win last August came off a stone-higher mark and she's shortlisted now back in the groove

runners.name: Thats My Boy Luke
runners.spotlight: Dual Ripon winner last summer who's regressed and run below market expectations on last two starts; this is easier off a career-low mark (9lb lower than when last successful) but he could have done without the recent rain.
runners.comment: Dual Ripon winner last summer who's regressed; could have done without the recent rain

runners.name: Due Respect
runners.spotlight: Just a single win to her name but showed more on her first crack at this trip at Ayr a fortnight ago, when going off hard in front and only letting Hostelry past; 4lb better off with that one today and this course should suit her style; player.
runners.comment: Burned them all off bar Hostelry last time; 4lb better off with that one today; player

runners.name: Approaching Dawn
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in June who didn't quite see it out over 1m1f here last time; not the easiest and often misses the break but a big field at this slightly lower level looks ideal; one to consider.
runners.comment: C&D winner in June; big field at this slightly lower level looks ideal; one to consider
runners.owner: D P Van Der Hoeven & D G Pryde

runners.name: Abu Royal
runners.spotlight: Sole win came at Ayr; among the market leaders back there early last month on first crack at 0-50 company, but finished well held behind Approaching Dawn; given a second go in a visor today, switched from cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Below market expectations when well held behind Approaching Dawn at Ayr last time

runners.name: Sievier
runners.spotlight: Poor in five runs for Jack Channon, finishing tailed off on her sole start last year; entitled to have needed her recent comeback for her new trainer, who also saddles Caledonian Dream, but didn't show enough to warrant serious consideration today.
runners.comment: Poor in five runs for Jack Channon; well held on her recent comeback for her new yard

runners.name: Jewel Maker
runners.spotlight: Generally struggled this season and the years look to be catching up now; an easy 1m such as this would have been a bare minimum even in his pomp and Thats My Boy Luke may be his yard's best chance.
runners.comment: Generally struggled this season and the years look to be catching up; easy 1m a minimum

runners.name: Bantz
runners.spotlight: Dual 7f winner who's pulled hard and not seen it out in three previous tries over this trip; shown very little in five runs for his current yard in any case.
runners.comment: Dual 7f winner who's pulled hard and not seen it out in three previous runs over this trip

runners.name: Joshuas Dream
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden who was going beyond 6f for the first time when said to have hung right throughout in first-time cheekpieces (retained) at Ayr a fortnight ago (7f); hard to make a case, with Approaching Dawn looking his trainer's best shout.
runners.comment: Regressive maiden who goes up in trip again; hard to make a case for him

runners.name: Caledonian Dream
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden for two previous yards who ran poorly for his current trainer a few months ago on his return from almost a year off; since been gelded and doesn't make obvious appeal.
runners.comment: Ran poorly for his current trainer a few months ago on his return from almost a year off

runners.name: Elizabeth Bay
runners.spotlight: Maiden who's gone sharply the wrong way for this yard, running poorly in three starts this season; didn't look to see out 1m2f (soft) two months ago and this is easier again but she's hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Didn't look to see out 1m2f (soft) latest; this easier again but she's hard to recommend

runners.name: Serengeti Sunrise
runners.spotlight: Fair 2yo for George Scott but generally struggled for his current trainer; brought over from Ireland twice early in the year (AW), when unplaced each time, and is some way down the pecking order back from a break.
runners.comment: Brought over from Ireland a couple of times early in the year (AW) when unplaced each time

runners.name: Nogo's Dream
runners.spotlight: Running consistently all season and the handicapper continues to give him every chance (5lb lower than when last successful); ran well on his only previous start here too but he's ultimately made a career of getting beaten at short prices.
runners.comment: Running consistently all season and the handicapper continues to give him every chance

runners.name: South Shore
runners.spotlight: Back to something like his best since the hood came off for this yard, winning twice this summer and going back up a stone in the weights; another solid effort off this mark in an apprentice handicap at Windsor last Monday and looks set to go well once more.
runners.comment: Back to something like his best since the hood came off for this yard; set to go well

runners.name: Kento
runners.spotlight: Consistent and likes it here; 7lb better off with Secret Handsheikh than when second to him over C&D earlier in the month but he's spent most of his career running in lesser company and currently is weighted to his best; faded late over 6f here on Sunday.
runners.comment: Consistent and likes it here; weighted to his best and this is tougher than he's used to

runners.name: Em Four
runners.spotlight: Back on his last successful mark (AW) and wins at Epsom and Chepstow (both on good ground) last summer suggest today's course should be fine; won't mind the return to 5f, either, having been pestered in front last time, and is one to consider.
runners.comment: Back on his last successful mark; won't mind the return to 5f and is one to consider

runners.name: Merrimack
runners.spotlight: In-form front-runner who has two wins, a second and two thirds to his name in five runs here; on career-high mark, though, having been put up 5lb for his Newmarket win early in the month under 7lb claimer Chloe Lyons.
runners.comment: In-form front-runner who likes it here; arrives on a career-high mark though

runners.name: Secret Handsheikh
runners.spotlight: Notched a third win over C&D earlier in the month; that race rather fell into his lap, though, with the leaders going off too hard, and he'll find today's company tougher off a 6lb higher mark; not disgraced, having made late headway, here (6f) on Sunday.
runners.comment: Notched a third win over C&D earlier in the month; not disgraced here on Sunday

races.race_name: Cognitive Law EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Rogue Imperial
runners.spotlight: Best effort yet on his nursery debut at Lingfield (6f, good to firm) early in the month; was allowed his own way in front against the favoured rail that night but he sets the standard on that back in a maiden.
runners.comment: Best effort yet on his nursery debut early in the month; sets the standard on that

runners.name: Roll Up Raymond
runners.spotlight: Best of the rest when some way off a couple of useful-looking 2yos on his Newmarket debut (6f, good to firm) recently; hard to know the merit of that as yet but he sat last for a long way in a messy affair and this is somewhat easier.
runners.comment: Best of the rest behind two useful-looking 2yos on debut recently; this is somewhat easier

runners.name: I Am Royal
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to three winners, two of whom went close on 2yo debut (one for this yard, which boasts a much better record with 2yos on the AW than turf, including this season); holds a sales-race entry next month and the market will guide.
runners.comment: Half-brother to three winners; holds a sales-race entry next month; the market will guide

runners.name: Major Looktwice
runners.spotlight: Yard far from known for juveniles (0-19 this season), especially first time, but this 45,000euros breeze-up 2yo offered a bit of promise behind the two market leaders on recent Windsor debut; entitled to improve.
runners.comment: Bit of promise behind the two market leaders on his Windsor debut; entitled to improve

runners.name: From Me To You
runners.spotlight: Exposed maiden who looked worth another try at this trip when not beaten far in a 5f AW nursery last time; has more on his plate back in maiden company though as he would have been 12lb better off with Rogue Imperial in a handicap.
runners.comment: Exposed and has more on his plate back into maiden company; vulnerable now

runners.name: Happy Daisy
runners.spotlight: Started 66-1 and ran as the market predicted on her Newmarket debut a few weeks ago; she'll need to take a big forward step.
runners.comment: Started 66-1 and ran as the market predicted on her Newmarket debut; needs much more

runners.name: Be An Angel
runners.spotlight: Cheekpieces had a positive early impact during a good spell for her yard last month but she's been below par as favourite the past twice; much will depend on the effect of a new form of headgear.
runners.comment: Cheekpieces had a positive early impact; much will depend on the new form of headgear

runners.name: Unico
runners.spotlight: Wins have come in the spring and autumn, latterly over 5.3f here last autumn off 2lb higher; has been given a summer break since two poor efforts and is some way down the pecking order.
runners.comment: Given a summer break since two poor efforts and is some way down the pecking order

runners.name: Rye
runners.spotlight: Consistent maiden who hung right at Goodwood in June (6f; good to soft may have been slower than ideal) when favourite; has gone well fresh more than once and is surely up to winning off this mark when it falls right; one to consider.
runners.comment: Has gone well fresh more than once and is up to winning off this mark when it falls right

runners.name: Dark Sun
runners.spotlight: Generally in good form since cheekpieces went on but she's been costing herself with slow starts lately; won't mind coming back up from 5f and much will hinge on how she gets on at the stalls.
runners.comment: Generally in good form since cheekpieces went on; much will hinge on how she gets away

runners.name: Blue Anthem
runners.spotlight: Progressive in the first half of last year for George Boughey before being sold for 21,000gns in the autumn; has struggled in Ireland this year but was well backed last time and the booking of Billy Loughnane draws the eye with first-time visor added.
runners.comment: Irish raider; backed last time; booking of Billy Loughnane draws the eye in new headgear

runners.name: The Organiser
runners.spotlight: Dual soft-ground winner, latterly over C&D last autumn off an 8lb higher mark; has been running over 7f in recent times and the question is whether he still has the toe for this trip under today's conditions.
runners.comment: Running over 7f in recent times; question is whether he still has the toe for this trip

runners.name: Nordic Glory
runners.spotlight: Dual firm-ground Bath winner this season, latterly off 3lb lower for Owen Lewis late last month; as high in the weights now as he's been for a few years and his record round here is nothing exciting.
runners.comment: Dual firm-ground Bath winner in 2026; as high in the weights as he's been for a few years

runners.name: Von Krolock
runners.spotlight: Has gone close on turf but his five wins, including four for this yard, have come on the AW; a 4lb penalty for last Tuesday's Lingfield Polytrack win, back in the blinkers, leaves little room for manoeuvre.
runners.comment: Five wins, including four for this yard, have come on the AW; needs more under a penalty

races.race_name: Ian Carnaby 30 Years Of Sponsorship Handicap

runners.name: Crimson Road
runners.spotlight: Decent 3yo who's enjoyed a revival round Chepstow of late, beating a subsequent winner off 7lb lower last month before following up a fortnight ago; every chance of completing the hat-trick.
runners.comment: Decent 3yo who's enjoyed a revival round Chepstow of late; every chance of the hat-trick

runners.name: Bobacious
runners.spotlight: Keen-going front-runner who landed a second Epsom victory (also a C&D winner) when showing the right attitude to get back up late last month; won back-to-back races last summer and no surprise to see history repeat itself upped a fair 2lb.
runners.comment: Keen-going front-runner who showed the right spirit last time; claims upped a fair 2lb

runners.name: It's Life
runners.spotlight: Resumed from a layoff in good nick, her stamina carrying the day over 1m on comeback before a solid effort off her revised mark over C&D last time; one to consider under Billy Loughnane in first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Back from break in good nick; one to consider under Billy Loughnane in first-time headgear

runners.name: Bohemian Breeze
runners.spotlight: Made it 3-3 over C&D with two wins for Tom Queally, who's back up today, in June; didn't look to see out 1m4f in better company here last time, when hanging left as usual; this is more his level.
runners.comment: Made it 3-3 over C&D with two wins for Tom Queally (back up today) in June; considered

runners.name: Bownder
runners.spotlight: Goodwood/Lingfield winner who's been running well all summer without looking to have anything in hand off this mark, latterly when splitting a couple of subsequent winners over C&D early last month; looks set to go well again.
runners.comment: Running well all summer without looking to have anything in hand off this mark; player

runners.name: Twilight Guest
runners.spotlight: He's always gone well here but has struggled during what's been a quiet year thus far for his yard, including when twice well held behind Bohemian Breeze in June; hard to recommend in a competitive handicap.
runners.comment: Always gone well here but struggled this year; hard to recommend in a competitive handicap

runners.name: Star Mind
runners.spotlight: Wildly inconsistent mare who was hit with a sharp rise for an easy Leopardstown win in April; twice well held at the same course since for an Irish trainer who has also declared Blue Anthem in the 3:30
runners.comment: Wildly inconsistent mare who's struggled twice since an easy Leopardstown win in April

runners.name: Liberate
runners.spotlight: Goodwood novice winner for James Horton last spring who tumbled down the weights in Ireland this season; solid in the market for her new yard at Newmarket on Friday and that was a step back in the right direction.
runners.comment: Solid in the market for her new yard on Friday; that a step back in the right direction

races.race_name: Streamline Taxis Always Going The Distance Handicap

runners.name: Monks Mead
runners.spotlight: His only win since 2023 came in a classified at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) in January; has made the frame in four of his last five starts and holds place claims.
runners.comment: Sole win since 2023 came in AW classified in January; in the frame in 4 of last 5 starts

runners.name: River Wharfe
runners.spotlight: Course specialist who landed his sixth win on this track earlier this month, in a C&D classified; beaten at odds-on over 7f here 24 hours later but will be more at home back over 1m and must be on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Won C&D classified this month; below best 24 hours later; will be more at home back at 1m

runners.name: Heer's Sadie
runners.spotlight: Three 7f wins at this track but has also won at 1m; resumed winning ways in a classified at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) ten days ago but back up 5lb and will find it tougher back in a handicap.
runners.comment: Three 7f wins at this track but has won at 1m; latest win in a classified; tougher today

runners.name: Sangara
runners.spotlight: 0-9 when trained by Jack Channon; shaped encouragingly when staying on to finish fifth of nine behind River Wharfe over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago on reappearance and stable debut and may finish closer this time.
runners.comment: Reappearance and stable debut when staying-on 5th behind River Wharfe over C&D recently

runners.name: Winemaker
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner (5f-7f) when based in Ireland; below form in two runs for current stable and his stamina for 1m is still unproven after fading over C&D 18 days ago (went off fast).
runners.comment: Five-time winner (5f-7f) when based in Ireland; stamina still unproven over 1m

runners.name: Celtic John
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in a classified at Lingfield (1m, AW) in January; hasn't matched that form since and needs to do better; on career-low mark.
runners.comment: Sole success came in 1m classified at Lingfield in January; hasn't matched that form since

runners.name: Chloe's Courage
runners.spotlight: Just 1-20, her sole success coming at Chelmsford (7f, AW) last December; beaten in a classified on Tuesday and needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: 1-20, her sole success coming at Chelmsford last December; beaten in classified latest

runners.name: Dalmally
runners.spotlight: Won C&D maiden in October 2024 for Hughie Morrison but has struggled in handicaps since; the switch to current yard has not changed his fortunes and he's showing little sign that he is ready to take advantage of a declining mark.
runners.comment: Won C&D maiden in October 2024 but has mostly struggled in handicaps despite falling mark

runners.name: King David
runners.spotlight: Just 1-26 and that was on AW in 2024; has yet to be placed from five runs on turf and his turn is more likely to come when back on AW.
runners.comment: Just 1-26 and that was on the AW in 2024; has yet to be placed from five runs on turf.

races.race_name: Brighton Racecourse Antiques And Vintage Fair Handicap

runners.name: Superstorm
runners.spotlight: Appreciated the step back up from 6f when finally off the mark over C&D earlier this month; showed the right attitude that day for Mikkel Mortensen and it will only have boosted confidence; one to consider upped a fair 2lb.
runners.comment: Finally off the mark over C&D earlier this month; one to consider upped a fair 2lb

runners.name: Barry The Worm
runners.spotlight: Nursery win last backend (Tapeta) came in first-time cheekpieces; maybe the switch to first-time blinkers will do the job but it's hard to find any other positives, with him struggling this year and having stamina to prove.
runners.comment: Struggled this year and has stamina to prove; much hinges on the new form of headgear

runners.name: Berning Hot
runners.spotlight: C&D win last August came off 4lb higher but she's struggled since returned to turf, including back here earlier this month; hard to back her with conviction currently.
runners.comment: Struggled since returned to turf; hard to back her with conviction currently

runners.name: Mister Sandman
runners.spotlight: Beaten-favourite in five of his last six starts, latterly behind Thanks Dad at Yarmouth, and has tended to pull hard/not see it out in a few starts at beyond sprint trips; capable off this mark but is still a maiden and comes with risks attached.
runners.comment: Beaten-favourite in five of his last six starts; capable but comes with risks attached

runners.name: Girls Allowed
runners.spotlight: Almost got up at Yarmouth last time (weak 0-50 classified event); more on her plate back into handicap company in first-time headgear but it's still early days with her.
runners.comment: More on her plate back into handicap company in new headgear but still early days with her

runners.name: Kondratiev Wave
runners.spotlight: Three-time course winner who remains consistent despite his age; recent strike-rate isn't great but he's down to 0-55 for the first time since returned to turf and Billy Loughnane is an obvious plus.
runners.comment: Three-time course winner; remains consistent despite his age; recent strike-rate not great

runners.name: Nautical Sky
runners.spotlight: Well-related filly who wasn't entirely without hope for James Ferguson, ignoring a poor one last month; new trainer has done the trick so many times with new recruits that she'd have to be considered in first-time headgear should the market speak her way.
runners.comment: New trainer has done the trick so many times with new recruits; the market will guide

runners.name: Neat And Tidy
runners.spotlight: Big prices and well held in six runs for three yards; didn't see out 1m last time and it's too soon to put a line through her but would want to see some support before considering her.
runners.comment: Big prices and well held in six runs for three yards; would want to see some support

runners.name: Thanks Dad
runners.spotlight: Always been best on the AW but off the mark on turf in a 0-50 classified event ten days ago; did a lot of racing over this trip in the past but does seem more effective over 6f these days and history suggests he's no good thing to back up Yarmouth.
runners.comment: Seems more effective over 6f now; history suggests he's no good thing to back up Yarmouth

runners.name: Minella Post
runners.spotlight: 0-6 over hurdles; fell at the second-last when holding every chance in a Cork maiden hurdle last month (17.5f, good); easy to forgive latest effort in the Tribes at Galway; cheekpieces worn that day are left off; rated 113 and obvious chance.
runners.comment: Has shown enough to suggest he can win maiden, can forgive last run, obvious chance

runners.name: Coolishael
runners.spotlight: Placed in one of two point-to-points; again placed in a Punchestown bumper in May (2m, good); showed an aptitude for hurdling when an 8.5l second in a maiden at the same venue (16.5f, good) and the winner Lizzie Twigg has won twice since; this longer trip should suit and leading claims if ready after break.
runners.comment: Form of Punchestown second well-advertised by winner, big chance if ready after break

runners.name: Vargas
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in both points and beaten 112l in a Downpatrick bumper; can only be watched on hurdling debut.
runners.comment: Pulled up in both points, tailed off in Downpatrick bumper, can only be watched

runners.name: Elusive Truce
runners.spotlight: Elusive Pimpernel mare; dam unraced half-sister to Swedish Derby winner Moe Green out of unraced sister to 1m2f Group 3 winner Scribe and 1m2f Listed winner Northern Hal; likely best watched.
runners.comment: Elusive Pimpernel mare, dam a half-sister to useful Our Power, watch unless backed

runners.name: Colliers Quay
runners.spotlight: Finished in the frame in three of five point starts; respectable fifth in 2m2f Galway bumper on rules debut; should strip fitter for that and bred to make a jumper; place chance.
runners.comment: Respectable fifth on rules debut in Galway bumper, bred to make a jumper, place chance

runners.name: Noharmintrying
runners.spotlight: Getaway gelding; closely related to bumper/2m4f hurdle winner Delta Run, half-brother to winners Theclockisticking (useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase) and Clay Pigeons (point/bumper/1m7f hurdle); dam unraced sister to Synchronised; appeal on paper and yard in form; check the market.
runners.comment: Getaway gelding, makes appeal on paper and yard is in form, check the market

runners.name: Tommy Go Maith
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in all three starts over hurdles; impossible to make a case for.
runners.comment: Pulled up in all three starts over hurdles, impossible to fancy

runners.name: Myhero La Colmine
runners.spotlight: Choeur Du Nord gelding; dam French 2m4f chase winner, half-sister to 2m4f hurdle/chase winner Hold Up La Colmine (by Choeur Du Nord), out of French 2m1f hurdle winner; check the market.
runners.comment: Choeur Du Nord gelding, fam French 2m4f chase winner, check the market

runners.name: Roll It Roisin
runners.spotlight: No impact in two points and tailed off at 100-1 on hurdles debut at Killarney; others preferred.
runners.comment: No impact in points, tailed off when 100-1 on hurdles debut, others preferred

runners.name: Don't Tell Paddy
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; Telescope gelding; unraced dam a half-sister to classy jumpers Nuts Well and Runswick Royal; worth a market check if gets a run.
runners.comment: Telescope gelding, dam unraced half sister to two classy sorts, check market; reserve

runners.name: Lexenna
runners.spotlight: First reserve; impossible to fancy on the evidence of heavy defeats in two bumpers and a maiden hurdle here when 250-1.
runners.comment: Impossible to fancy on evidence of first three runs; reserve

runners.name: Leva Deva
runners.spotlight: Heavy defeat in a bumper and no impact in two starts over hurdles at huge odds; look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Heavy defeat in bumper, no impact at huge odds in two starts over hurdles

runners.name: Lastofthenatives
runners.spotlight: No impact in points or in first three starts over hurdles; hood needs to transform.
runners.comment: No impact in points or in first three maiden hurdles, new hood needs to transform

runners.name: Beyond Forgiveness
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; pulled up in a point and remote sixth (beaten 50l) in a maiden hurdle at Cork; more needed.
runners.comment: Pulled up in point, remote sixth in maiden hurdle at Cork, much more needed; reserve

runners.name: Sankofa
runners.spotlight: Showed ability when third in a point at Curraghmore in April; sent off at 40-1 on first start in this sphere at Cork and was beaten 64l; much more needed.
runners.comment: Placed in point, beaten 64l when 40-1 on hurdling debut, much more needed

runners.name: Discrete
runners.spotlight: No joy in points and not much encouragement to take from heavy defeats at big odds in a bumper and two maiden hurdles; seems safe to rule out.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats at big odds in a bumper and two maiden hurdles, safe to rule out

runners.name: Nothintodowithme
runners.spotlight: Unlikely winner based on tame efforts at huge odds here and at Tramore.
runners.comment: Unlikely winner based on tame efforts here and at Tramore, oppose

runners.name: Green Grass
runners.spotlight: Beaten a cumulative distance of 126l in maiden hurdles at Kilbeggan and Tramore; may do better when tackling handicaps.
runners.comment: Tailed off in maidens at Kilbeggan and Tramore, may do better when handicapping

runners.name: Manoir De Mirande
runners.spotlight: Has got his act together over hurdles; made all in a 17.5f maiden hurdle at Sligo (good) and followed up in a novice hurdle over this C&D (good); posted another solid effort in a 2m2f novice hurdle at Sligo on latest; obvious chance in first handicap with rider taking off 7lb.
runners.comment: Backed up Sligo maiden win with C&D novice success, another solid run latest, chance

runners.name: Ocean Murphy
runners.spotlight: Gained breakthrough win in decisive fashion at Wexford last month (2m4f, good); raised 6lb and came up short in follow-up bid over the same C&D; this is a stronger race so work to do off the same mark.
runners.comment: Won impressively on penultimate, raised 6lb and beaten latest, this a deeper race

runners.name: Houndsworth
runners.spotlight: Won off 8lb lower at Cork in April (2m, yielding); back to form with solid 2.25l fourth of 14 here over 16.5f (good) on latest; has weakened late on both previous starts at this sort of trip so stamina a concern.
runners.comment: Won off 8lb lower at Cork in April, solid fourth over shorter here latest, stamina a query

runners.name: O'Grady Cracker
runners.spotlight: In excellent form since return from a break, winning successive handicaps at Kilbeggan (2m3f, good) by 12l and at Cork (2m2f, good) by 8l; has gone up a total of 23lb and this is a tougher race but there could be more to come.
runners.comment: Up 23lb for easy wins at Kilbeggan and Cork, this tougher but may be more to come

runners.name: William F Browne
runners.spotlight: Flat winner is 0-5 over hurdles; showed a glimmer of promise when fifth in a Galway novice but beat just one rival home on handicap debut at Sligo five days ago; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: 0-5 over hurdles, beat just one rival home on h'cap debut at Sligo, others preferred

runners.name: Nile Star
runners.spotlight: Struggled badly on heavy ground earlier this year but has shown improved form on good ground in maiden hurdles at Wexford and Sligo since returning from a break; not obviously well treated and this looks a tough race in which to make his handicap debut.
runners.comment: Improved for good ground last twice, this a tough race in which to make handicap bow

races.race_name: Paddy Smyth Memorial Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Cool Native
runners.spotlight: Point winner was third of 22 in decent Navan maiden hurdle last November; tongue-tied, filled same spot behind useful winner over 2m2f at Downpatrick last month, where she couldn't lie up but came home well up the hill; this trip might suit.
runners.comment: Third to useful winner over 2m2f at Downpatrick last month, coming home well up the hill

runners.name: Amina
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to smart hurdler Altobelli; good level of bumper form in four well spread-out appearances; 5/6 fav, looked paceless on hurdling debut over 2m3f at Downpatrick where she missed at the last two obstacles; trip likely to suit and yard in much better form now.
runners.comment: Looked paceless on hurdling debut over 2m3f at Downpatrick; trip likely to suit

runners.name: Goodgollymissholly
runners.spotlight: Well held under her penalty at Killarney after winning a bumper at Roscommon; plenty of winning hurdlers further back in her pedigree, but stable second string and again penalised for this jumps debut.
runners.comment: Well held under her penalty at Killarney after winning a bumper at Roscommon; hurdling bow

runners.name: Run For Power
runners.spotlight: Ocavango 6yo is from a family with which the yard has done very well; only beaten 3l on hurdling debut at Killarney last October (winner rated 102); betting suggested she'd need Wexford comeback and steps up in trip now.
runners.comment: Only beaten 3l on hurdling debut at Killarney last October; fitter for Wexford comeback

runners.name: Castle Garden
runners.spotlight: Daughter of Kew Gardens out of unraced half-sister to modest winning jumper; third in good-ground point in May.
runners.comment: Daughter of Kew Gardens was third in good-ground point in May

runners.name: Ronnie's Rascal
runners.spotlight: Third to a smart winner in 2m1f academy hurdle at Cork last October; not as good in similar contest following month; made the running when fourth to Goodgollymissholly in Roscommon bumper last month; fitter for that and tongue-tie goes on; chance if longer trip suits.
runners.comment: Third to smart winner in 2m1f academy hurdle last October; fitter for latest bumper fourth

runners.name: Daphne Blake
runners.spotlight: Policy Maker newcomer out of maiden pointer; family of smart jumper Atone; best watched.
runners.comment: Policy Maker newcomer out of maiden pointer; family of smart jumper Atone; best watched

runners.name: Labondance
runners.spotlight: French import was fourth on only hurdles start; then ran in six chases, placing twice including when second over this trip; not seen since a fall in November; a dark one and the market will tell plenty; tongue-tied all starts.
runners.comment: French import was fourth on only hurdles start; second in 2m6f chase; market useful

runners.name: Gunner Girl
runners.spotlight: Daughter of Westerner out of 2m-2m1f hurdle/chase winner; well beaten in two bumpers.
runners.comment: Daughter of Westerner out of 2m-2m1f hurdle/chase winner; well beaten in two bumpers

runners.name: Free A Minute
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden pointer and well beaten in a maiden hurdle and a bumper.
runners.comment: Modest maiden pointer and well beaten in maiden hurdle and a bumper

runners.name: I Dont Really Care
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in a bumper; keen on hurdling debut at Sligo where well-beaten fourth over 2m2f.
runners.comment: Tailed off in bumper, keen on hurdling debut at Sligo where well-beaten fourth over 2m2f

runners.name: Clash Gold
runners.spotlight: Her Sligo second was in a modest restricted maiden; only rated 90 and likely to struggle, although this longer trip may help.
runners.comment: Her Sligo second was in a modest restricted maiden; only rated 90 and likely to struggle

runners.name: Doesthatmakesense
runners.spotlight: Big prices and poor form, including when tried in headgear last time.
runners.comment: Big prices and poor form, including when tried in headgear last time

runners.name: Gerrys Wish
runners.spotlight: Left behind previous two modest runs to finish a 2.25l second of 13 at Wexford (3m, good) in first-time blinkers (retained); should be in the mix if the headgear works again.
runners.comment: Back to form in first-time blinkers at Wexford, in the mix if headgear works again

runners.name: My Good Pal
runners.spotlight: Back from a spell chasing with a solid effort at Downpatrick (2m6f, good), beaten just 1.25l into second of 10; nudged up 2lb, so remains 8lb above sole success, but yard red hot so should be on the premises again.
runners.comment: Nudged up 2lb for Downpatrick second, 8lb above sole win but yard red hot, chance

runners.name: Giorgia Rose
runners.spotlight: Has finished remote third in all three maiden hurdles at 20.5f-24.5f on good ground; with shrewd yard so needs monitoring in the market on handicap debut.
runners.comment: H'cap debutante, third in all three maidens at 20.5f-24.5f, shrewd yard, check market

runners.name: Barryroe Madam
runners.spotlight: Won at Listowel (23.5f, good) off 5lb lower in May last year; subsequently went close off revised mark at Punchestown (3m, gd-yld) and Galway (3m, yielding) and is now 5lb lower than when beaten 1l in the latter race; positive signs at Wexford latest and enters calculations now.
runners.comment: Has slipped to a feasible mark, positive signs at Wexford latest, enters calculations

runners.name: It's Time Again
runners.spotlight: Three wins over hurdles at this venue including over C&D; however, has failed to fire so far this year and was beaten 15l on latest over C&D (good); however, is now 3lb below her last winning mark so can't be written off.
runners.comment: Three-time course winner, below best this year but now 3lb below last win, can't discount

runners.name: Princess Felicia
runners.spotlight: Maiden has made a promising start for Harry Kelly; decent third at Clonmel followed by a close second at Tramore (20.5f, good) on latest; nudged up 3lb and stamina to prove at this distance but should go well again.
runners.comment: Narrowly denied on latest at Tramore, up 3lb and in trip, should go well again

runners.name: Joshua Chamberlain
runners.spotlight: Was off the track for almost three years but a respectable fourth over C&D last month proved he still retained ability; would probably prefer softer ground, however.
runners.comment: Latest C&D fourth proved he still retained ability, would probably prefer softer ground
runners.owner: J R Robinson & Mrs E Keane

runners.name: Fine Print
runners.spotlight: AW Flat winner extended his record over hurdles to 0-7 when beaten 40l at Downpatrick earlier this month; not a bad run on the level at Tramore since but much more needed back over timber.
runners.comment: 0-7 over hurdles, okay run on Flat latest, beaten 40l last start over timber, needs more

runners.name: The Vegas Raider
runners.spotlight: Last won over hurdles here (2m1f, yld-sft) in August 2024; went close over C&D off 6lb higher in April 2025; below that level in just three runs since, including when beaten 26l here on latest (16.5f, good); needs a revival.
runners.comment: Course winner, lost way since second here in April 2025, needs a revival

runners.name: Phildante
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over hurdles at Wexford on latest (3m, good), showing a willing attitude to score by a neck; 4lb rise for that seems fair but not sure this drop back in trip will suit.
runners.comment: Up 4lb for breakthrough win over 3m at Wexford, not sure this drop back in trip will suit

runners.name: Tantrum Boy
runners.spotlight: First reserve; ran a nice race over C&D on penultimate off this mark, beaten 5.75l into fourth; filled the same position at Roscommon last time; needs to find a bit more to get his head in front.
runners.comment: Promise on last two starts including over C&D, needs to find more to win; reserve

runners.name: Ranger Billy
runners.spotlight: On long losing run but did run into third over C&D on his penultimate start; not at his best here two weeks ago, however, so needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: On long losing run, below best here on latest, needs to bounce back

runners.name: Chanceitlucky
runners.spotlight: Maiden shaped like he'd improve plenty for the run when a respectable 11.5l fifth of 16 over C&D, under a positive ride, on his return from a break two weeks ago; interesting.
runners.comment: Should come on for pleasing C&D run after break two weeks ago, interesting

runners.name: Tawny Lea
runners.spotlight: Very modest form so far in maiden hurdles and on handicap debut at Kilbeggan on latest; can only be watched for now.
runners.comment: Modest form in maidens and on handicap debut at Kilbeggan, can only be watched

runners.name: Ballyminnion Boy
runners.spotlight: Yet to show winning potential and struggled on handicap debut at Wexford 17 days ago; hood goes on.
runners.comment: Yet to display winning potential, heavy defeat on handicap debut latest, hood on

runners.name: Ancient Myth
runners.spotlight: Flat winner showed little in maiden hurdles and similar story on handicap debut at Killarney when he never travelled; eased 2lb and blinkers now tried.
runners.comment: Flat winner, very modest form over hurdles so far, blinkers now tried

runners.name: But What About Me
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; maiden has been absent since April 2025 and is best watched on first start for new handler.
runners.comment: Maiden has been absent since April 2025, new yard, best watched; reserve

runners.name: St Anthonys Corner
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; won on debut here over 16.5f (good) in May 2024 but hasn't looked like adding to her tally since; off since heavy chase defeat at Sligo in October; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Won on debut here in May 2024, no joy since, off since Oct', hard to fancy; reserve

runners.name: Blackwater Soldier
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point winner hasn't cut much ice in maiden hurdles at 2m4f-3m on varying ground; hood worn the last twice is left off and rider booking a plus but will surely need this after mammoth absence.
runners.comment: Point winner, poor maiden form, hood left off for h'cap bow, may need this after absence

races.race_name: BOYLE Sports Home Of The Early Payout Chase

runners.name: Addragoole
runners.spotlight: Won around Sligo last year and handicap winner over this trip at Leopardstown's Christmas meeting; also ran well when third at DRF; 2m6f was too far in the Galway Blazers, but fitter for that and this looks a good opportunity.
runners.comment: Last win was over this trip at Leopardstown's Christmas meeting; 2m6f too far at Galway

runners.name: Jazzy Matty
runners.spotlight: Excels at Cheltenham; first and second in last two runnings of the Grand Annual over 2m; first run since April when well beaten in 2m6f hurdle at Killarney on Saturday, getting tired from two out; best in at the weights if he turns out again, but that must be doubtful.
runners.comment: Smart 2m handicap chaser; well beaten in 2m6f hurdle at Killarney on Saturday

runners.name: Bowensonfire
runners.spotlight: Smart handicap hurdler won a big pot at Leopardstown in February; good second on chasing debut at Galway, but well-beaten third behind two good horses at Killarney on Saturday.
runners.comment: Smart handicap hurdler; well-beaten third on second chase start at Killarney on Saturday

runners.name: Ma Jacks Hill
runners.spotlight: All four chase runs have been at around 2m4f; won novice chase at Punchestown in June; held in pair of handicaps since, beaten 8l at Kilbeggan last time; stiff task at weights, even with 7lb off, and shorter trip no help.
runners.comment: Winner over 2m4f and beaten 8l in handicap over that trip last time; stiff task at weights

runners.name: Runcok
runners.spotlight: Winner over hurdles and fences in these colours when with Willie Mullins; poor last of four in last year's renewal; yet to convince with his jumping (can go left), and again made a couple of errors when beaten 20l in Galway handicap on second start for yard.
runners.comment: Ex-Willie Mullins; well beaten in last year's renewal; beaten 20l in Galway handicap chase

runners.name: Bunting
runners.spotlight: 132-rated hurdler, although only a maiden win to his name, and decent stayer on the Flat as well, third in last season's Cesarewitch; has been hard to place over hurdles, front-running sixth over 2m6f at Galway last time; not bred for this game and stiff task on chasing debut.
runners.comment: 132-rated hurdler and decent stayer on the Flat as well; stiff task on chasing debut

runners.name: Donnie Devito
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over hurdles has plenty of chasing experience; after seven months off, nice return to action when third at Wexford; bad mistake early on and nearly lost rider when 11-1 for Galway Blazers, doing well in the circumstances to finish seventh and that race is working out well.
runners.comment: Plenty of experience over fences, but made mistakes last time when seventh at Galway

runners.name: Mickie Angel
runners.spotlight: Placed in five of his eight starts over fences, including twice in handicaps and rated 120; lacks a gear but will be plugging away.
runners.comment: Placed in five of his eight chases, has handicap experience; has the ceiling rating of 120

runners.name: Jolie Jewel
runners.spotlight: Dual winner over hurdles and rated 114 over fences after three solid efforts over shorter; placed on last four visits here, so likely to give a good account and stepping back up in trip is a plus.
runners.comment: Dual winner over hurdles, rated 114 over fences after three solid efforts; not out of it

runners.name: Rusty Harkness
runners.spotlight: Homebred gelding is by Walk In The Park and dam was a Grade-1 winning chaser for Willie Mullins; won 3m maiden hurdle at Kilbeggan last month; promising second to useful sort on chasing debut at Limerick in May; has the build of a chaser and likely to be prominent.
runners.comment: Won 3m maiden hurdle at Kilbeggan; promising second on chasing debut prior to that

runners.name: Kevin's Pride
runners.spotlight: Bumper and 2m4f maiden hurdle winner, but he's not the quickest and has looked laboured over his fences in first two chase starts over 3m1f.
runners.comment: Not the quickest and has looked laboured over the fences in first two chase starts

runners.name: Jeroboam Machin
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to useful chaser and won sole point; landed two bumpers, including a Leopardstown Grade 2, but went missing for two years until returning this spring; much better on third hurdles run when narrowly beaten over 2m6f in Galway when tongue-tie/cheekpieces combination seemed to perk him up; goes without those aids now on chase debut.
runners.comment: Point winner and dual bumper winner, including Grade 2; good run over hurdles at Galway

runners.name: Maverick Mack
runners.spotlight: Second in sole point and won heavy-ground maiden hurdle; clear round the priority on this chasing debut after three non-completions over hurdles.
runners.comment: Second in a point; clear round the priority here after three non-completions over hurdles

runners.name: Fou De Toi
runners.spotlight: Been a little disappointing over hurdles (now rated 113) and this is no easy task on chasing debut; has King's assistance and half-brother was a chase winner in France.
runners.comment: Been a little disappointing over hurdles and this is no easy task on chasing debut

runners.name: Slurricane
runners.spotlight: Flat and hurdles winner not coming here in great form; very much Flat-bred and best watched on chasing debut, with yard having stronger contender in Donnie Devito.
runners.comment: Flat and hurdles winner not coming here in great form; best watched on chasing debut

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies INH Flat Race

runners.name: The Lodge Lane
runners.spotlight: Maxios filly comes from the family of Grade 1-winning bumper performer Lovethehigherlaw; 10s, fair third to a Mullins-trained newcomer at Wexford; second ran okay againsts geldings next time.
runners.comment: Third to Mullins-trained newcomer at Wexford; second ran okay against geldings next time.

runners.name: She Was The One
runners.spotlight: Vadamos half-sister to useful bumper/2m4f hurdle winner Demandrivingdouvan; bought in for £25,000 after finishing second in a point; good start under rules when third of 18 at Galway, done for pace turning in, but only beaten by a couple of the fancied ones.
runners.comment: Second in a point; good start under rules when third of 18 at Galway

runners.name: Elegantemente
runners.spotlight: No Risk At All newcomer bought for E90,000 as 2yo; half-sister to three winners including Excelero (useful 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase) and Kapeloi (French 2m6f Listed chase); dam placed 2m2f hurdle/chase in France, half-sister to French 2m4f/2m6f Grade 1 chase winner Oculi.
runners.comment: No Risk At All newcomer bought for E90,000 as 2yo; half-sister to three winners

runners.name: Queens Counsel
runners.spotlight: Jukebox Jury newcomer; dam won a bumper and was useful jumper for Jessica Harrington; family of classy chaser In Compliance; tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Jukebox Jury newcomer; dam won a bumper and was useful jumper for Jessica Harrington

runners.name: River Moy
runners.spotlight: Two nice runs and was green under pressure when beaten less than 2l at Sligo last time; drops back in trip from 2m2f
runners.comment: Green under pressure when beaten less than 2l at Sligo; drops back in trip from 2m2f

runners.name: Hee Hiles
runners.spotlight: Yeats half-sister to yard's winners Friary Road (bumper/2m hurdle), Hardwired (2m1f-2m7f hurdle/chase) and Be Fierce (1m7f chase/2m hurdle); dam bumper (inc Listed) and 2m/2m2f hurdle winner.
runners.comment: Yeats half-sister to yard's Friary Road (bumper/2m hurdle winner) from a good family

runners.name: Zara's Dream
runners.spotlight: Walk in The Park homebred; dam 1m7f-2m2f Flat winner and Grade 1-winning hurdler; family of smart 2m hurdle/chase winner Wild Passion.
runners.comment: Walk in The Park homebred; dam 1m7f-2m2f Flat winner and Grade 1-winning hurdler

runners.name: Indoor Sport
runners.spotlight: Unfancied but showed ability when beaten 15l at Cork last month, finishing fair way off the first three; hood stays on.
runners.comment: Showed ability when beaten 15l at Cork last month, but was fair way off the first three

runners.name: She Means Business
runners.spotlight: Nice page; 14-1, keen and didn't finish off when mid-field at Roscommon, but travelled into contention nicely aginst geldings; not far off fifth who won last week; hood should help.
runners.comment: Nice page; 14s, keen and didn't finish off when mid-field at Roscommon; hood should help

runners.name: Rathnaleen Aj
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to last month's Galway Blazers winner Kings Hill; 33s, was beaten 27l on debut at Wexford.
runners.comment: Half-sister to Galway Blazers winner Kings Hill; 33s, was beaten 27l at Wexford

runners.name: Mastertown Miss
runners.spotlight: Well-bred daughter of Yeats; second of 7 in ordinary Clonmel maiden hurdle in early April; later that month, was beaten 21l against geldings in a valuable sales' bumper at Punchestown; that form untested, but she obviously has a fair measure of ability.
runners.comment: Second of 7 in Clonmel maiden hurdle; fair run against geldings in Punchestown bumper

runners.name: Ailbhes Gift
runners.spotlight: Diminutive daughter of Planteur from a good family; weakening fourth when falling in Fairyhouse academy hurdle last November; well held in another such race following month; tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Weakening fourth when falling in Fairyhouse academy hurdle; well held in similar race

races.race_name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Sunday Girl
runners.spotlight: Frankel filly who made a promising start with third of 11 in 6f maiden at Newbury 12 months ago; absent subsequently but remains with potential and a likely key player.
runners.comment: Promising start with Newbury third a year ago; remains with potential; likely key player

runners.name: Encore
runners.spotlight: 17-2, shaped encouragingly when fifth of nine in 7f Kempton novice on her debut for Ed Walker last September; off since but this daughter of Hello Youmzain can't be ruled out now starting out with another leading yard.
runners.comment: Encouraging debut fifth at Kempton for Ed Walker; off 11 months but not ruled out

runners.name: Queen Of Hope
runners.spotlight: 3,000gns 3yo; dam, 7f/1m winner (RPR 93), is a half-sister to useful winners Positive Impact (7f/1m) and Turntable (1m-1m2f); the market can guide for this Pinatubo filly on her first run.
runners.comment: The market can guide for this Pinatubo filly on her first run

runners.name: Cercis
runners.spotlight: Has shown fair form to make the frame in 6f Nottingham maiden and 7f Doncaster novice this summer, runner-up in four-runner event on latter occasion; likely needs to take a step forward to gain a first win here though.
runners.comment: Runner-up in four-runner event at Doncaster latest; likely needs to take a step forward

runners.name: Just Dreaming
runners.spotlight: Sent off 100-1 but took a big step forward with second of seven in 6f Salisbury novice 12 days ago; needs to back it up now.
runners.comment: Big step forward with second in 6f Salisbury novice 12 days ago; needs to back it up now

races.race_name: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C and D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Nakila Sun
runners.spotlight: Torquator Tasso colt who was much improved from his debut when a nose second of nine in 7f AW Lingfield maiden last month; strong at the finish there so he can go very well now stepping up to 1m.
runners.comment: Nose second in 7f AW Lingfield maiden; he can go very well now stepping up to 1m

runners.name: Camarda Rc
runners.spotlight: Looked an excellent prospect when overcoming inexperience to make a winning debut in novice at Epsom (7f, good to firm) last month, forging clear last 1f; this son of Masar holds a Group 1 Dewhurst entry and is very much the one to beat despite conceding weight all round.
runners.comment: Looked an excellent prospect when winning on Epsom debut; the one to beat under a penalty

runners.name: Regalism
runners.spotlight: Blue Point colt who took a step forward from his debut when third of five in 7f Brighton novice 18 days ago; he can do better still but likely needs to here.
runners.comment: Step forward when third of five at Brighton; can do better still but likely needs to here

runners.name: Son Of A Fish
runners.spotlight: Improved on his initial fifth with third of four in 7f Doncaster novice nine days ago; he may do better still but yard also has Camarda Rc in here.
runners.comment: Improved with third at Doncaster nine days ago; he may do better still

runners.name: The Sergeon
runners.spotlight: 21,000gns foal; Sergei Prokofiev colt; half-brother to Group-placed 5f winner Show Me Show Me (RPR 100); dam, Hungarian 7f-1m winner, is a half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Too Cool For School; a noteworthy newcomer.
runners.comment: Sergei Prokofiev colt; a noteworthy newcomer

runners.name: Distant Sun
runners.spotlight: 42,000gns yearling; half-brother to 1m2f winner Guesstimate (RPR 78); dam, unplaced over 1m-11.6f (RPR 65), is a sister to useful winners Evaluation (1m6f-2m Flat and 2m hurdle) and Calculation (1m2f-14.5f), out of Gold Cup winner Estimate; this Australia colt needs considering on debut, especially if the market vibes are positive.
runners.comment: This Australia colt needs considering, especially if the market vibes are positive

runners.name: Aethelstan Gold
runners.spotlight: 35,000gns yearling; half-brother to winners Sassi Neri (1m4f AW; RPR 73) and Tax Holiday (US 1m turf); dam, placed over 1m2f-1m4f (RPR 68), is a half-sister to Group 1 winners Japan (1m2f/1m4f) and Mogul (1m4f) and 1m2f Group 2 winner Secret Gesture; this son of Saxon Warrior can't be ruled out on his first start.
runners.comment: This son of Saxon Warrior can't be ruled out on his first start

runners.name: Biscaysian
runners.spotlight: 16-1, hinted at promise with debut fifth of nine in novice at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm) 22 days ago, keeping on late; more can be expected from this son of Bayside Boy over this longer trip.
runners.comment: Hinted at promise with debut Yarmouth fifth; more can be expected over this longer trip

runners.name: Hoosthat
runners.spotlight: Well held in maidens at Leicester (7f) and Southwell (1m) this summer; significantly more is required from this Land Force colt.
runners.comment: Well held in maidens at Leicester (7f) and Southwell (1m) this summer

runners.name: Banged Up
runners.spotlight: Built on debut with sixth of nine in 7f Epsom novice 25 days ago; this son of Without Parole needs to take another step forward now.
runners.comment: Built on debut with sixth at Epsom 25 days ago; needs to take another step forward now

races.race_name: Play The Free £20,000 Matchbook Match 6 Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Cape Fear
runners.spotlight: Landed 11.5f novice at Lingfield in June; ran well in first-time cheekpieces when second of nine in 1m2f handicap at Chester 22 days ago; can race off a 1lb lower mark here so bold showing is on the cards in retained headgear.
runners.comment: Ran well in first-time cheekpieces at Chester; bold showing on cards off 1lb lower here

runners.name: Morcar
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Lingfield (1m2f) in May and backed it up with a good second of five at Sandown (1m2f) following month; must enter calculations after a break.
runners.comment: Good second at Sandown in June; must enter calculations after a break

runners.name: Just An Hour
runners.spotlight: On a losing run but he's proving consistent this season and posted a solid third of six in 1m2f handicap here two weeks ago; this course winner ought to be thereabouts once more.
runners.comment: Solid third here two weeks ago; this course winner ought to be thereabouts once more

runners.name: Raulin
runners.spotlight: Signed off for David O'Meara with 1m4f handicap success at Ripon in June; changed hands for 36,000gns subsequently and not out of things for his new yard with tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Signed off for David O'Meara with Ripon win; not out of things for new yard

runners.name: Tai Hang Pegasus
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressing in handicaps and he comfortably gained a first success in five-runner event at Brighton (1m2f) 18 days ago; not taken lightly despite a 6lb weights hike.
runners.comment: Comfortably off the mark at Brighton; not taken lightly despite 6lb weights hike

runners.name: Melek Alreeh
runners.spotlight: In winning form on the AW at Wolverhampton (1m4f) in the winter but failed to beat a rival on his return from five months in 1m4f handicap at Newmarket last month; has something to prove now.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival at Newmarket last month; has something to prove now

runners.name: Percival
runners.spotlight: Fair 1m2f winner in France for Andre Fabre; not discredited when in the frame in 1m2f handicaps at Sandown and Lingfield for his new yard this summer; can't be dismissed.
runners.comment: In the frame at Sandown and Lingfield for his new yard this summer; not dismissed

races.race_name: Bet £20 Get £40 In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap

runners.name: Buckland Belle
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over C&D in May and added 1m Leicester victory in July; looked the likely winner until colliding with rail late on when third in 1m2f Brighton handicap last time; big shout off an unchanged mark.
runners.comment: C&D scorer; likely winner until collided with rail at Brighton latest; big shout

runners.name: Berkshire Boom
runners.spotlight: A fair 7f juvenile winner; largely running with credit this season and not seen to ideal effect when 12th in 1m Kempton handicap two weeks ago, racing wide; a likely player from a slipping mark for yard among the winners.
runners.comment: Largely running with credit this season; a likely player for yard among the winners
runners.owner: Berkshire Parts & Panels Ltd No1 Fanclub

runners.name: Torbados
runners.spotlight: Remains winless but he got right back on track with second of ten over C&D two weeks ago; needs to build on that effort if he's to gain a first success at the 12th attempt.
runners.comment: Right back on track with second of ten over C&D two weeks ago but is still a maiden

runners.name: Sup Of Red
runners.spotlight: Yet to score but has some fair form to her name and she shaped as if the run was needed after three months off when fifth of seven in 7f Chepstow handicap last time; possibilities.
runners.comment: Shaped as if run was needed when fifth in 7f Chepstow handicap last time; possibilities

runners.name: Who Is Alice
runners.spotlight: A fair 7f scorer last term for Jack Channon; yet to show that form for her new yard this season and beat only one rival at Chepstow (7f) last month; wears first-time hood.
runners.comment: Out of sorts this term for new yard; fitting of hood needs to help

runners.name: Ecclefechan
runners.spotlight: 0-15 but he wasn't discredited when a staying-on third of six in 5f Musselburgh handicap 17 days ago; has his stamina to prove over this markedly longer trip, though.
runners.comment: 0-15 but not discredited with third at Musselburgh latest; has his stamina to prove

runners.name: Molly Mac
runners.spotlight: Thriving for her current yard and bids for a hat-trick after bagging a pair of 6f handicaps at Nottingham and Newmarket; up another 4lb but still merits serious consideration.
runners.comment: On hat-trick after Nottingham and Newmarket wins; merits serious consideration

runners.name: Star Obsession
runners.spotlight: Frankel filly who has been off the track since a free-going fourth of eight in 1m Kempton maiden in February; tongue tied for her handicap debut and could still do better now dropping markedly in trip.
runners.comment: Off since free-going fourth at Kempton in February; could still do better back in trip

runners.name: Koffee And Kale
runners.spotlight: Winless this season and he came in a below-par sixth of 11 over C&D 11 days ago; more is required if he's to double his tally.
runners.comment: Winless this season and he came in a below-par sixth of 11 over C&D 11 days ago

runners.name: Angel Summer
runners.spotlight: Remains winless and never able to land a blow in 5f handicaps here and at Newmarket for her new yard this summer; this return to further will suit, though, so she's no forlorn hope with a tongue tie added.
runners.comment: Never able to land a blow both runs for new yard; this return to 6f will suit, though

runners.name: Magic Lady Mae
runners.spotlight: A fair 7f maiden for Richard Hannon but hasn't offered much in a trio of runs over 7f for her current yard; cheekpieces are reached for here.
runners.comment: Hasn't offered much in a trio of runs over 7f for her current yard; cheekpieces go on
runners.owner: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya

runners.name: Cape Toronada
runners.spotlight: On the up since sent handicapping and she gained a second win of the summer in 6f handicap at Brighton 19 days ago; remains on a workable mark and very much one to consider.
runners.comment: On the up and gained second win at Brighton; on a workable mark and very much considered

runners.name: Beach Partee
runners.spotlight: A three-time 5f/6f scorer as a 2yo; on a losing sequence this season and he came in only eighth of 11 over C&D 11 days ago; needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: On a losing sequence and eighth over C&D 11 days ago; needs to take a big step forward

runners.name: Hellcat
runners.spotlight: 0-8 and she started very slowly when a below-par sixth of ten in 6f Wolverhampton handicap last month; not easy to make a case for.
runners.comment: 0-8 and started very slowly when below-par sixth in Wolverhampton handicap last month

runners.name: Venetian Romance
runners.spotlight: Fair maiden who signed off for Dr Richard Newland and Jamie Insole with a good second of six in 7f Brighton handicap in June; changed hands for £8,000 since and not out of things for her new stable after a break.
runners.comment: Good second at Brighton in June; not out of things for her new stable after a break

runners.name: Dragon God
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at Yarmouth (5f) in August and didn't enjoy the smoothest of passages when a good third of seven under a 5lb penalty at Brighton (6f) 17 days ago; a player off a 2lb lower mark here.
runners.comment: Won at Yarmouth then good Brighton third; a player off a 2lb lower mark here

runners.name: Faustus
runners.spotlight: On a long losing sequence but recent form includes a couple of encouraging efforts and he did too much up front when fifth of six at Brighton (5f) 19 days ago; needs considering eased 1lb.
runners.comment: Did too much up front at Brighton (5f) 19 days ago; needs considering eased 1lb

runners.name: Darkened Edge
runners.spotlight: In fine form this summer and bids for a hat-trick following 5f victories at Chepstow and Bath; up 3lb but not taken lightly in her current mood.
runners.comment: Bids for hat-trick following wins at Chepstow and Bath; up 3lb but not taken lightly

runners.name: The Bear Of Saints
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo; second run back after 21-month absence when a good third of six in 5f Leicester handicap last month; well in the mix eased 1lb with a hood added.
runners.comment: Good third in Leicester handicap last month; well in the mix eased 1lb with a hood added

runners.name: Desdemona
runners.spotlight: Landed back-to-back 5f AW handicaps at Lingfield and Chelmsford early in 2026 but she's failed to beat a rival in her last three starts, back on turf at Brighton last time; hard to warm to.
runners.comment: Failed to beat a rival on her last three starts, at Brighton last time; hard to warm to

runners.name: Em Jay Kay
runners.spotlight: Scored at Lingfield (6f) in January but below par since, only tenth on a rare turf start at Newmarket (6f) ten days ago; not easy to make a case for.
runners.comment: Scored at Lingfield (6f) in January but below par since; not easy to make a case for

runners.name: Our Planet
runners.spotlight: Made a winning start for this yard at Leicester (5f) last July but he's offered little in 5f handicaps at Lingfield and Newmarket this summer; others appeal more.
runners.comment: Offered little in 5f handicaps at Lingfield and Newmarket this summer; others appeal more

runners.name: Trafalger
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo; yet to hit top form in handicaps here (6f) and at Chepstow (5f) this summer; needs to take a step forward despite a falling mark.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 5yo; yet to hit top form in h'caps here and Chepstow this summer

runners.name: Just Jump
runners.spotlight: Refused to race here in May but he has since won over C&D and posted a good third of ten in 6f AW Lingfield handicap when hindered by a customary slow start; likely player if on his A-game again.
runners.comment: Refused to race here but has since won over C&D; good Lingfield third latest; considered
